PHONETelephoneParticipation by voice communication where the voices of the communicating parties are transported over an electronic medium
VIDEOCONFVideoParticipation by voice and visual communication where the voices and images of the communicating parties are transported over an electronic medium
FACEIn-PersonParticipation by voice communication where parties speak to each other directly.
